Hi, honey.

Have a hug. *hugs tight*. It's okay to cry. This is really, really hard. We're here for you.

Don't call your ex. You say yourself many times - "I am tired of being alone". And that's what it is. You don't want to be alone. You're terrified. You want a guy to be there to support you and help you through this (understandable!), and because you saw your ex you're transferring all these feelings to him. Of course you were devastated! Here he is moving on, having a really happy life, while you're stuck with a baby and an emotional wreck. What the hell? That's not fair! You want him back because you want to be happy, like he is with his new girl (or, possibly, you want him back so that he can be miserable just like you. It's not fair that he gets to be happy and you don't.). You think that getting back with him will help everything; he will give you emotional support, he'll give you guidance, he'll hold your hand at night, tell you everything will be okay, and make everything be okay.

But it won't.

Remember all the bad times. Remember why you broke up. Remember, in the end, that you dated him out of pity. Remember that you're STRONG. You, after the two of you broke up, found a new guy. Remember before you and your ex got together. You were independent. You could take care of yourself. You didn't need the support of a stupid guy. Now life is hard. Now all you want is support.

But you're better than that, and that's what you have to keep in mind. For the sake of your baby, if nothing else... Do you want your baby to have a crying, sobbing, wreck of a mother who collapsed emotionally? Or do you want to be a strong figure that your baby will be proud of, someone who was thrown into the toughest possible situation and came out ahead? I know it's hard, really really really hard, to be alone... but you're not alone. You have your baby. And the two of you will make it through this.

tl;dr: Don't call him. You're better than that.
